tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa rdo rje gnam lcags mchu zhes bya ba bzhugs/

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya badz+ra lo ha duṇ+ḍa nā ma dhā ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rdo rje gnam lcags kyi mchu zhes bya'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das yul ma ga dha na rgyu zhing a mra'i tshal du gshegs te phyin nas/ a mra'i tshal du lus 'phags ri'i dbang po'i brag phug na bzhugs so// de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug go /de nas tshangs pa dang*/ khyab 'jug dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba bgyis nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das bdag cag thams cad 'dus nas/ klu thams cad kyi snying 'phrog par bgyid pa/ snying 'gyes par bgyid pa/ klu ma rungs pa rnams kyi rigs phung bar 'gyur ba/ rlung dang ser ba'i sprin dang*/ ma rungs pa thams cad bzlog par bgyid pa/ me tog dang*/ 'bras bu dang*/ lo tog 'byor par bgyid pa/ rdo rje gnam lcags mchu zhes bya ba'i gzungs brjod par 'tshal gyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa'i slad du byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tshangs pa dang*/ khyab 'jug dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu rnams ngas sems can thams cad kyi don dang*/ 'phags pa thams cad kyi bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis smros shig ces bka' stsal pa dang*/ de nas tshangs pa dang*/ khyab 'jug chen po dang*/ dbang phyug chen po dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi yis gzungs sngags smras so// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// pha rol zil gyis gnon pa'i mthu bo che rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten gsum gyi gtso bo la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal po chen po bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje gnam lcags mchu 'bar ba ma rungs pa drag tu dgod pa la phyag 'tshal lo// ma tha ma tha/

pra ma thā pra ma thā/ dz+wa li ta bhi kri ta/ badz+ra dz+wa ya dz+wa ya/ ma hā ba ya bir+ya pa ra kra ma/ ko ṭa ra tsa ya/ pra ma bha bu bu ma/ pra ma sa re/ bho bho nā ga di pa di pa bhi sa ra ma dha/ pra ma dha na/ na mur dha nan/ spo ṭa ya na/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ bha ra bha ra/ bharna tsakra dā dā na/ bho ba na/ ge na dre/ ma ti ka ma de/ bha sna tsa kre na/ shi na ra ci na da me/ hu ti hu ti/ li hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mu du mu du/ ha na du sarba duṣ+ṭan/ bha sbo dā ya/ hri da ya/ ma ha shwa re/ dzi la di tri shu da ra da ra/ ha na ha na/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mu tsi mu tsi/ du tsi ba bha ba bha ba/ k+ṣa ne k+ṣa ne/ tsa tu ra nān/ ma hā rā dzā nan/ dza li ti sha ga ti/ dha ru dha ra/ phu phaṭa/ s+phu ra s+phu ra/ bh+yo s+phu ra bh+yo s+phu ra/ tsa ra rba tsa ra rba/ tsa ra bha/ na zhu shu ya du sta nā ga hri da yā/ s+phu ta yā/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ du sta a sha ni/ bhad ta ma ga shi byi la rgya tsa la/ birma ku ru hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ phaṭa swā hā/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ bho nā gi ti pa ti bh+yo tsan dhu ya bho bho ya bho bho du/ ti du ti du/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ bha dzi ya a shi ni/ na sh+ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ bha dz+wa ya a shi na/ na sh+ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sarba nā ga hri da ya ni/ bi s+pho ṭa ya kā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ bhu tā ba lo ki te ya swā hā/ bu ma ya swā hā/ byis bhu ra ya swā hā/ ma hā sha ra dz+wa li/ ti shu lu ye swā hā/ tsa tu dha ma re dza sa ma da ra ye swā hā/ bu tsa ka ya phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ di ri di ri swā hā/ dz+wa ba li hi bha ga ti ye swā hā/ dzu ti dzu ti swā hā/ hā phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rdo rje 'bar ba gnam lcags mchu zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di thos ma thag tu/ klu ma rungs pa rnams rul nas/ dri mi zhim pa rnams mnams par 'gyur ro// lus so sor zhig cing khro bar gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la gtugs te/ 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das bdag cag lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten du thams cad kyis smad par gyur/

bdag cag ni ma rungs par gyur to// bcom ldan 'das slan chad 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad la gnod par mi bgyid/ 'gum par mi bgyid/ chung ngu na mig gis blta bar yang mi bgyid na/ skabs btsal bar ba lta ci smos/ rgya mtsho'i klu'i rgyal po glang po lta bu dang*/ klu'i rgyal po gdugs lta bu dang*/ klu'i rgyal po mthu che ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos gtugs te phyag 'tshal nas/ klu thams cad kyis dus phyi ma'i tshe/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad la me tog dang*/ 'bras bu dang*/ lo tog dang*/ lo ma dang*/ yal ga thams cad bsrung bar bgyi/ rlung dang*/ ser ba dang*/ tsha ba thams cad gcod par bgyid/ dus dus su char gyi rgyun yang dbab par bgyi'o// rang gi dam tshig dang*/ yi dam dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam tshig rjes su bsrung bar bgyi'o// sems can thams cad kyi re ba yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ yid la bsams pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyid pa dang*/ gnod par mi bgyid do// sdom pa yang 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das kyi khyad par gyi yon tan 'di las 'gal bar bgyid na/ bdag cag kyang byang chub mchog tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par mi gyur/ de'i bro tshig kyang 'di lags te/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ta ki ki taḥ ghu li ghu li/ mu li/ sha sha gu gu shi ti/ bī ru ti/ hu yu hu yu/ hu ri ti ha/ char che ba'am/ char mi 'bab pa'am/ dus ma yin par char babs pa 'am/ rlung dang sprin dang*/ dus ma yin pa'i rlung dang*/ gnam lcags ltung ba'i tshe/ rig 'dzin gyi bro tshig 'di khang thog gam/ sa mthon po'i steng ngam/ ri'i steng yang rung*/ kha shar phyogs su bltas te/ lan bdun du skad chen por bzlas nas/ yungs kar la lan bdun bzlas te gyen du gtor na/ gtor ma thag tu klu thams cad dum bur 'gyur zhing*/ nan tan du byas pas myur du char 'bebs so// dril bu la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te/

phyogs bzhir kha bltas nas dkrol na/ mtshams gcod par 'gyur ro// rdo rje la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas rlung 'gag par byed do// lan gcig dran pa tsam gyis rlung dang*/ ser ba dang*/ sprin zlog par byed pa'o// gnam lcags kyang chur 'gyur ro// rdo rje klad la bskor zhing phyogs gang du bskor ba der ser ba 'byol lo// nangs par gnas dben par 'dug ste/ lan nyi shu rtsa gsum du bzlas na rlung dang*/ ser ba dang sprin yang bkag cing klus gnod par mi byed de/ phyis kyang mi tshugs so// yungs kar la bsngags nas phyogs bzhir gtor na/ lo gcig tu mtshams bcad de/ rlung dang*/ sprin kyang mi g.yos te/ gang bsgo ba nyan cing rgyun du bsrung zhing gsal bar byed par 'gyur ro// gnod pa byed pa thams cad bsal to// legs par khrus byas te/ skad gsal bas bzlas te/ phyogs bzhi dang*/ bla 'og tu yungs kar gyis gtor na/ ser ba dang*/ rlung dang*/ klu gnod par byed pa bcings par 'gyur ro// ltas ngan pa dang*/ mi dge ba dang*/ bkra mi shis pa dang*/ gza' dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ sha za dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po thams cad bcings par 'gyur ro// dpag tshad 'khor yug tu mtshams bcad par 'gyur ro// bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/ tshangs pa dang*/ 'jug sred dang*/ dbang phyug la sogs pa yi rangs te/ mngon par bstod do// rdo rje gnam lcags mchu zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// /zhus dag /dge'o/// /
